title: THEY DIDN'T SEE YOU COMING. 🌩️
paragraphs: The world loves to predict your limitations. They want to put your faith in a predictable box. But a Spirit-filled believer cannot be contained by a human forecast.

Stop apologizing for your boldness. Stop shrinking back to make others comfortable. You weren't called to just survive the weather; you were called to change the atmosphere. When God is within you, you become the storm they never expected.
🔥 "The wind blows where it wishes, and you hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it goes. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit." — John 3:8
Are you ready to break the mold? Follow ⚔️ @iamGospelWarrior ⚔️ for daily armor.
